title: Outboard Flap Track and Carriage — Wear Measurement

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Measurement of wear at the outboard flap track and carriage with the flap extended, using the two-point method that replaced the removal-based measurement and reading against the revised limits.

sections.purpose: To measure the wear at the outboard flap track and carriage and to establish whether it is inside the published limits without removing the carriage.
sections.job_setup_note: The flap must be extended to the measurement position given in the task and supported on the trestle before any person works under it. Hydraulic power must then be removed and the system depressurised. The measurement is taken at two defined points on the track, and the gauge must be zeroed on the unworn reference land before each set of readings. Two persons are needed.
sections.procedure: Put the safety barriers in position under the wing. WARNING: KEEP CLEAR OF THE FLAP AND ITS TRACK WHILE THE SURFACE IS MOVING. THE CARRIAGE PINCH POINT IS NOT GUARDED. Extend the flap to the measurement position. Put the flap support trestle in position and take the weight. Remove hydraulic power and depressurise the system. Fit the safety pins at the flap drive. Clean the track running surface at both measurement points and remove the grease. Zero the wear gauge on the unworn reference land at the inboard end of the track. CAUTION: DO NOT MEASURE THROUGH GREASE OR THROUGH A BURR. A FALSE LOW READING WILL PUT A WORN TRACK BACK INTO SERVICE. Take three readings at the first measurement point and record the mean. Take three readings at the second measurement point and record the mean. Examine the carriage roller set in the actuator assembly DEL97190-24 for flat spots, for surface break-up and for evidence that the roller is not turning. Measure the carriage side play at the flap fully extended position. Compare all readings with the limits, which differ between the delivered roller set and the revised set. Re-grease the track running surface.
sections.close_out: Remove the safety pins at the flap drive. Restore hydraulic power and retract the flap, watching the track through the full travel. Remove the flap support trestle and the safety barriers. Record the two track wear means, the carriage side play, the roller condition and which limit set was used. Refer any reading outside the limits to the repair scheme before further flight.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The limit set differs on aircraft post MOD-111394.

safety_precautions: Keep clear of the flap and its track while the surface is moving.
Support the flap on the trestle before any person works under it.
Fit the safety pins at the flap drive before measurement.
